reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the preferred position for this rule is the absence of any non-solicit binding Customer; the cited general provisions (independent contractor status, severability/survival) contain no restrictive covenant and the survival list omits any non-solicit, supporting absence.
No redline or counterparty comment was proposed, which is correct for a compliant finding — the rendered redline is identical to the original paragraphs.

The failed deterministic checks (duration ≤ 12 months, general-solicitation carve-out) are inapplicable here: they test the wording of an existing non-solicit, and none exists, so their failure is not evidence of an error.
Rationale is accurate and appropriately records this as internal evidence of compliance rather than a negotiation issue; no over-flagging.
